title: Prototype first
sub: The opening film of Small steps, measured, the last series of Data management: deliver in small steps. Graham asks for a dashboard of room use; the question behind it is whether to build. Ten days after the team starts, a prototype with real, governed data is in front of him; three rounds of a week, each ending with the person who decides; an agent's draft checked by a person; and the rounds stop when the decision is served.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster: the team's rooms in daylight, with sheets pinned to the wall. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans and design (a round, a review, a definition), green is value or something done (a street people use, a first use, a decision served), orange is data (the bookings and the head counts), amber a risk, a cost or waiting (the building's price, the weeks a request waits, a booked room nobody uses), and violet only the team's agent.
